Next, venture east. If you can get through with that, try to head north. Then, make an attempt to venture east. Then, travel south. And then, head east. And then, head north. And then, attempt to head north. Following that, attempt to move west. After that, try to take a trip west. With that done, head north. Okay, and then, recover the coin from the floor of the ugly spare room. And if you do that, you're the winner!
